architecture: Web research runs in ChatGPT; GitHub Actions separately verifies structured procurement sources.
notes: Added Pontypridd Museum – upper gallery transformation as a 98% confidence Pitch. More than £257,000 of Welsh Government capital funding explicitly covers digital interpretation and interactive exhibits; Headland Design Associates is appointed for consultation, interpretation and exhibition design, so the likely route is downstream specialist delivery during detailed design and installation.

Added Taft Museum of Art – Duncanson murals immersive AR interpretation as a 98% confidence Pitch. A $159,733 FY2026 Museums for America award directly funds concept/design, content, prototype development, beta testing, installation and a portable digital experience.

Added SPARK Museum – Wonderlab interactive science gallery as a 98% confidence Pitch. A $75,000 FY2026 Inspire! award funds the design phase of a 3,000 sq ft hands-on gallery and explicitly requires documentation for future fabrication, creating a clear design-to-build pipeline.

Added miSci – Electric Revolutions interactive open-collections wall as a 98% confidence Pitch. A $94,987 FY2026 Museums for America award directly funds design and build of a 16.5-megapixel interactive collections wall.

Reviewed North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences' $795,382 immersive entrance/main-gallery project but did not add it because the funded scope is currently stronger in interpretive casework, graphics and wayfinding than in specialist interactive technology.
Reviewed additional FY2026 IMLS immersive/VR/digital projects and recent museum capital announcements; lower-fit, already-open or weakly actionable projects were rejected rather than added.
Existing verified tenders, manual records and Watch/Reject semantics were preserved. No general web source was promoted to Live Tender.
